# Rapid Video Downloader

Rapid Video Downloader is a browser-based tool at https://www.rapid-video-downloader.online/.

## What it does

- Inspects metadata for public or user-authorized media URLs.
- Shows title, creator, avatar, duration, date, views and likes when the source exposes them.
- Offers MP4 or MP3 options only when the source provides a usable public stream.
- Saves the resulting file through the user's browser.
- Can be installed as a progressive web app on supported Android, desktop and ChromeOS browsers; iPhone users can use Safari's Add to Home Screen action.

## Supported public sources

YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Reddit, Pinterest, Vimeo, Dailymotion and direct media URLs may be supported when they expose public media.

## Limits

- Private, login-required, DRM-protected and paywalled media is not supported.
- The tool does not bypass security checks or remove watermarks.
- Metadata and format availability depend on the source and server limits.
